info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows businesses to access and view the loyalty balances associated with their customers. This endpoint enables organizations to track customer rewards accumulation and current balance status, facilitating better customer engagement and retention strategies. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams, loyalty program managers, and marketing analysts who require insights into customer loyalty metrics. By providing real-time balance information, businesses can enhance customer interactions and improve loyalty program effectiveness.

get.summary: Retrieve the current balance of the loyalty account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current loyalty points balance associated with a user's account. It provides important information about the user's loyalty rewards status.
